Gentle acoustic music, spacious views, and moments of flowing water create a peaceful setting for a quiet break or an unhurried evening at home.
Let your screen become a window into the wilderness. Watch closely, settle in, and enjoy the changing light—or let the scenery bring a sense of mountain calm to your room.
Filmed and produced by Elizabeth & Olof Carmel for NatureStream.tv.
The nature footage is real and was filmed on location; no AI-generated scenery is used. Music generated with Suno AI, then selected, edited, and mixed for NatureStream.tv.
Run time: 1 hour, 44 minutes.
